'''KuatDriveSystems''' was a manufacturing company during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The company manufactured the [[A-9x thrust engine]] used on [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards']] [[A-9 Vigilance interceptor]].<ref name="EGVV" />
